description: This file serves as an index or export aggregator for various components related to cryptographic functions within the matrix SDK. It re-exports classes, functions, and types from multiple modules such as crypto-bootstrap, crypto-facade, decrypt-bridge, idb-persistence, verification-manager, and verification-status.

classes.name: MatrixCryptoBootstrapper
classes.description: A class involved in initializing or bootstrapping the matrix cryptographic operations.

classes.name: MatrixDecryptBridge
classes.description: A class providing decrypting functionalities bridging the cryptographic processes.

classes.name: MatrixVerificationManager
classes.description: A class managing verification processes and states.

methods.name: createMatrixCryptoFacade
methods.description: Function to create or instantiate the matrix cryptographic facade.

methods.name: persistIdbToDisk
methods.description: Function to persist IndexedDB data to disk storage.

methods.name: restoreIdbFromDisk
methods.description: Function to restore IndexedDB data from disk storage.

methods.name: isMatrixDeviceOwnerVerified
methods.description: Function to check if a matrix device owner has been verified.
